separation_rules.source_binding: Exact frozen sexuality source binding establishes Vera-specific source provenance only. It does not establish event authority, organic-context authority, behavioral qualification, provider currentness, durability, or phenomenology.
separation_rules.causal_execution: A source-bound runtime may perform bounded affective state transitions and allowlisted planning modulation without those transitions becoming production-qualified evidence.
separation_rules.authorization: ADMIN_FORCED_TEST and SELF_QUALIFICATION_TEST consume structured ALLOW/currentness evidence through a composition-bound verifier. The current Python verifier composition is in-process and therefore nonqualifying because same-process code can win first installation.
separation_rules.organic_context: Caller StimulusAppraisal.context_eligible is not upstream context evidence. Organic context eligibility must cross the same governed context boundary; the current in-process verifier composition remains nonqualifying for production evidence.
separation_rules.temporal_authority: Public advance_time() is affective simulation/recovery time. It may progress state dynamics but cannot satisfy privileged-trigger cooldown. Privileged cooldown uses runtime-owned monotonic observation of elapsed time.
separation_rules.restore_temporal_boundary: Monotonic timestamps are process-local and are not compared across restore. If a restored record establishes a prior forced trigger but no independently trusted cross-process wall-clock proof exists, restore requires a fresh privileged-trigger cooldown in the new runtime process.
separation_rules.receipt_provenance: In-process verifier evidence is preserved in receipts for auditability but is labeled IN_PROCESS_UNROOTED_NON_QUALIFYING. It cannot mint a new production ENGINEERED_ORGASM_ANALOGUE_OCCURRED claim. Resolution/recovery descendants preserve the same trust downgrade.
separation_rules.historical_replay: Source-bound historical/nonqualifying receipts may be structurally validated and replayed without treating exact source provenance as behavioral qualification.
separation_rules.provider_currentness: Authority/context evidence and provider currentness are separate trust domains. This boundary does not establish provider CURRENT or ATOMIC_DURABLE state.
separation_rules.phenomenology: No source, authorization, context, timing, state-transition, persistence, receipt, review, or qualification evidence in V1 establishes phenomenology.
